insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 3 G3+ games, 7/15 picks (47%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 46 champs in G1s, 13 in G3+.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Varus against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Varus against them in 18/30 games (60%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Azir? They go Ahri
insights.text: Azir is a G1 favorite (5/17 G1s, played by Fuuu). In the 12 later games where it was burned or banned, Fuuu went to Ahri (4/12) and Sylas (2/12).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Gwen is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Gwen in 12/30 games (40%): 2 picks (0-2) and 10 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Signature pick: Ashe
insights.text: They pick Ashe in 7/30 games (23%), 2.56x the league rate of 9%. Record 2-5.
